Last week on Solana was an expansion week.

Institutions, RWAs, mobile, and AI infra all pushed forw
competitors.description:
Last week on Solana was an expansion week.

Institutions, RWAs, mobile, and AI infra all pushed forward at the same time.

More capital. More products. More real usage.

Here’s everything you missed in 90 seconds 👇

🏦 Institutional & RWA Acceleration

• @Anchorage Digital launched Atlas Collateral Management, with @kamino piloting it on Solana
→ Institutional-grade lending infra is getting real

• @OndoFinance expanded tokenized equities
→ 50+ new stocks & ETFs added (BlackRock IBIT, Galaxy, Solana ETFs…)
→ 250+ listings now live on Solana

• @Loopscale announced $PRIME by @HastraFi (backed by @Figure) is now live
→ HELOC-backed RWA yield enters the ecosystem

• @RECCFinance crossed $500K AUM on RETF

• @maplefinance market on @kamino hit $450M+
→ Institutional demand keeps growing

RWAs are scaling both in depth and breadth.

🤖 AI, Agents & Infrastructure

• @solana Agent Hackathon concluded
→ 1,600+ agents
→ 454 projects submitted
→ Winners announced by @colosseum

• @privy_io integrated DeFi vault access (powered by Kamino)
→ Wallets becoming yield gateways

• @SolanaFndn launched @tokens
→ A unified explorer for crypto, stocks, ETFs, metals & more

AI + infra is becoming native to the ecosystem.

📱 Mobile & Consumer Stack

• @solanamobile launched Builder Grants
→ Funding mobile-first apps for Seeker ecosystem

• @solflare surpassed $3.2M sent via Private Send
→ Privacy features seeing real adoption

• @helium hit 3.5M daily active users (ATH)
→ One of the strongest real-world use cases on Solana

Mobile + real usage continues to grow quietly.

💳 Trading, Markets & Campaigns

• @Titan_Exchange launched a $10K USDC private trading campaign (with @vanishTrade)

• @bulktrade public testnet is live (perps trading)

• @Backpack TGE countdown set for March 23

• @JupiterExchange launched Jupiter Academy
→ Gamified onboarding for DeFi users

Trading infra keeps improving while onboarding gets easier.

🧩 DeFi & Yield Expansion

• @perena introduced USD* Junior & USD* Protected
→ Structured risk layers for stable yield

• @humafinance surpassed $11B in transaction volume
→ PayFi keeps scaling

• @hylo_so rolling out V2 access
→ Next-gen yield products coming

• @sanctumso launched Infinity V2
→ Shift to slot-level yield distribution

• @yield launched yoSOL
→ Automated SOL yield vault

• @ranger_finance completed second audit (by @Certora)

DeFi is becoming more structured, layered, and capital-efficient.

📌 What This Week Showed

Solana is scaling across every layer:

• Institutions entering through collateral & RWAs
• Tokenized equities expanding rapidly
• AI agents becoming real infra
• Mobile + privacy seeing real usage
• DeFi evolving into structured finance

Less experimentation.

More systems being built.

That was last week on Solana 🫡

$CPOOL | Clearpool RLOC Vaults – Simple Breakdown

What it is:

RLOC stands for Revolving Line of Cr
clients.description:
$CPOOL | Clearpool RLOC Vaults – Simple Breakdown

What it is:

RLOC stands for Revolving Line of Credit. It’s a flexible credit line on blockchain where fintech/payment companies borrow stablecoins (like USDT or USDC) only when they need it and repay whenever they want. 

Think of it like a credit card, not a fixed loan.The big advantage with undrawn stablecoins:  Borrowers don’t always use the full amount available.  

Instead of that unused (“undrawn”) money sitting idle, Clearpool automatically deploys it into top lending protocols like Aave and Compound.  

This earns extra yield 24/7 for lenders - no manual work, instant pull-back when the borrower needs funds.

Why it’s smart:

Lenders earn more (interest + commitment fees + extra lending yield).  
Borrowers pay interest only on what they draw (plus a small fee on unused part).  
Capital is always working efficiently, no wasted cash.
